notes: THE LEAD TEAM of the last ore train out of Morrow, dead in its yoke: two oxen at beast size, fallen the same way and staggered, the far one's stiff legs out across the tongue and the near one's back; each on its side with its legs rigid along the ground, a cream belly toward us, the head limp on the ground, a dark muzzle, big bone horns, a dun hide; the yoke beam across both necks at a slant, the tongue running off east to the wagon. Sketch B of three free sketches (art/review/morrow-kit/ox-team-sketches.png; picked by the Coordinator under Tyler's standing art sign-off, after four misses), polished palette-held by edit_image_pro_flash; then FIXED by hand after review b9 ("the hind legs trailing back: a team at a flying gallop"; "the tan hide the hottest thing on the road"): the trailing hind legs cut away and drawn again by rule sticking down-screen across the spine, the far ox's head sheared down to hang limp, the hide a value step down and greyer, the belly cream-grey (.scratch/kit/team/b10.mjs). Its horns stay bone pale (stone 4). Pixels unscaled.
